arguments.message: Hi there! When an incident is marked resolved, we add a written summary directly to the same incident entry on our status page. The summary includes what happened, the time window that was affected, and—if relevant—whether any customer data was impacted. For incidents where no data was affected, the summary explicitly states that there was no data impact. You can view the full summary by opening the incident on the status page; it will be listed alongside the live updates from the incident.
